label: SA-4(11)
title: System of Records

statement.prose: Include {{ insert: param, sa-04.11_odp }} in the acquisition contract for the operation of a system of records on behalf of an organization to accomplish an organizational mission or function.

guidance: When, by contract, an organization provides for the operation of a system of records to accomplish an organizational mission or function, the organization, consistent with its authority, causes the requirements of the [PRIVACT](#18e71fec-c6fd-475a-925a-5d8495cf8455) to be applied to the system of records.

params.label: Privacy Act requirements
guidelines: Privacy Act requirements for the operation of a system of records are defined;
